name: Sirmaur
shortFact: The crown of the Shivalik foothills.
description: Sirmaur is characterized by its agricultural richness, historical princely legacy, and the sacred Renuka Lake.
history: Sirmaur's earliest mention dates to 634 A.D. (as Surughna). The state was founded around 1095 A.D. by Subhans Prakash, a Rajput from Jaisalmer, after a flood destroyed the original capital at Sirmur. The Prakash dynasty ruled for centuries, with Raja Karam Prakash founding Nahan in 1616. A major historical event was Raja Medni Parkash providing asylum to Guru Gobind Singh at Paonta Sahib in 1684. Sirmaur was an independent 11-gun salute princely state until it merged with Himachal Pradesh in 1948.
culture: The culture is a blend of royal Rajput traditions and the tribal heritage of the 'Giripar' area. The 'Renuka Fair' is a major spiritual gathering celebrating the legend of Sage Jamadagni and his wife Renuka. Traditional sports like 'Thoda' (archery-based dance) are still vibrant. Sirmaur is known for its brassware, community-centric fairs, and the synthesis of Sikh and Hindu traditions at shrines like Paonta Sahib and Renuka Ji.

topSpots.name: Renuka Lake
topSpots.description: The largest natural lake in the state, believed to be the embodiment of Goddess Renuka.

topSpots.name: Paonta Sahib
topSpots.description: A historic Sikh shrine where Guru Gobind Singh lived and composed several holy scriptures.

topSpots.name: Nahan
topSpots.description: A beautifully planned hill city with grand palaces, historical gardens, and colonial streets.

topSpots.name: Churdhar Peak
topSpots.description: The highest peak in the Shivalik range, offering panoramic views of the Sutlej and Yamuna rivers.

cuisine.name: Sirmauri Ginger & Garlic
cuisine.description: Bold, aromatic spices cultivated in the fertile Giripar mountains, used in local slow-cooked meats.
cuisine.history: Sirmaur is the largest ginger-producing district in the state, with traditional farming methods passed down for generations.
cuisine.tip: Look for the locally made ginger candy and sundried garlic strings in Nahan markets.

wildlife.name: Himalayan Goral
wildlife.description: A nimble, goat-like antelope that thrives in the steep rocky slopes of the Renuka Wildlife Sanctuary.
